intended_use.summary: Evaluate the exact Google Distroless Node.js 24 Debian 13 nonroot image as a lower-attack-surface replacement for the blocked Docker Official Node artifact. This gate permits signature, metadata, license, SBOM and vulnerability inspection plus non-executing acquisition; it does not approve runtime use or redistribution.
planned_actions: pull exact linux/amd64 artifact without running it

sources.name: Google Distroless Node.js 24 Debian 13 nonroot exact image

evidence.note: The public discovery tag resolved to OCI index sha256:fbbdda866ea71aef98c4abece17e3d61fbf820cc2ef3961522caa2478716171a with linux/amd64 child sha256:f987682b3ea8d8e22497cb95edc5014d793612f7064e43df8104394db0ce19fe.
The official project lists nodejs24-debian13 with nonroot as a current published image and documents architecture-specific variants.

criteria.note: The mutable nonroot tag is discovery only; every approved action is bound to the exact index and linux/amd64 child digest.

evidence.note: GoogleContainerTools publishes and documents the Distroless image family and its gcr.io registry location.

criteria.note: Publisher authority is direct and independently signature-checkable.

evidence.note: Exact registry metadata was anonymously readable without a credential, account, purchase or terms interaction.

criteria.note: Only anonymous public registry access is permitted.

evidence.note: The official Distroless repository is Apache-2.0 licensed.

criteria.note: Controlled acquisition and evaluation are permitted. Redistribution remains blocked pending exact SBOM and component-license reconciliation.

evidence.note: The official project states that every Distroless image is keyless-signed and fixes the expected issuer to https://accounts.google.com and identity to keyless@distroless.iam.gserviceaccount.com.
The reproducible 1970 timestamps and Bazel layer history identify Debian 13 inputs and the nodejs24 payload, but do not substitute for a signed SLSA build statement.

criteria.note: Publisher provenance is independently verifiable. No official signed SLSA attestation was located during this gate, so full build provenance must remain a named limitation in the runtime disposition.

evidence.note: The exact 1,219-byte OCI index binds amd64 child sha256:f987682b3ea8d8e22497cb95edc5014d793612f7064e43df8104394db0ce19fe plus arm64, s390x and ppc64le children.

criteria.note: The exact index signature, exact amd64 child and local image identity must match; no tag fallback is permitted.

evidence.note: The project documents that standard Distroless images omit shells and package managers and currently supports Node.js 24 on Debian 13.
The exact amd64 config declares User 65532, entrypoint /nodejs/bin/node and working directory /home/nonroot.

criteria.note: The candidate fits a nonroot Node 24 runner, subject to exact offline vulnerability, license and runtime-contract checks.

evidence.note: Only public exact image metadata and signatures are accessed. The image remains unexecuted and receives no Docker socket, secret, mount, network or repository content.

criteria.note: Registry and verification tools receive no private project input or approval state.
